text: You shouldn't need to empty your savings to cancel Genius, since your savings balance is your money and isn't tied to the subscription. I can't see your account, though, so I can't confirm whether any Genius-specific savings features or perks would change after you cancel. To cancel, open the app, go to your Genius settings, and select the cancel option, where the app will show what changes before you confirm. If anything about your savings looks unclear there, reach out through in-app chat and the team can check your account directly.
